snippet.title: DreamWorld - Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
DreamWorld is an Infinite Sandbox MMO, For Builders By Builders. Check out our advanced building features like volumetric selection and copy/paste. Play with all your friends in one server. Build, craft, fight mobs and world bosses, and much more. Wishlist on Steam now to be informed of our next release!

Watch Streams (Fridays at 2pm PST): https://www.twitch.tv/playdreamworld 
Follow on Social: https://linktr.ee/playdreamworld
